description_en: Queries information such as the status and name, including running and completed instances
description_zh: 状态和名称等信息，包括运行中和运行完成的实例
name: SearchManualDagNodeInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the manually triggered workflow instance. This is the value returned by the createManualDag operation
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程运行实例ID，createManualDag接口返回的值
parameters.name: dag_id

NodeInsInfo.description_en: The list of task instances within the manually triggered workflow
NodeInsInfo.description_zh: 返回的手动业务流程内部运行任务的列表

BeginRunningTime.description_en: The time when the task started running

BeginWaitResTime.description_en: The point in time when the task started waiting for resources
BeginWaitResTime.description_zh: 开始等待资源的时间点

BeginWaitTimeTime.description_en: The point in time when the task started waiting for the scheduled time
BeginWaitTimeTime.description_zh: 开始等待时间的时间点

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

DagId.description_en: The ID of the workflow instance

DagType.description_en: The type of the workflow. The value 5 indicates a manually triggered workflow
DagType.description_zh: 业务流程类型，5标识手动业务流程

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the task finished

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the task was last modified

NodeName.description_en: The name of the task node

ParaValue.description_en: The parameter information of the task

Status.description_en:
The status of the task:

Not running: Not all upstream instances have succeeded. For example, NOT_RUN(1, "Not running").

Waiting for the scheduled time (dueTime/cycleTime) to arrive. For example, WAIT_TIME(2, "Waiting for time").

Submitted to the execution engine and waiting for scheduling. For example, WAIT_RESOURCE(3, "Waiting for resources").

Running. For example, RUNNING(4, "Running").

Execution completed, submitted for data verification. For example, CHECKING(7, "Checking").

Execution completed, performing branch condition verification. For example, CHECKING_CONDITION(8, "Checking condition").

Execution failed. For example, FAILURE(5, "Failed").

Execution succeeded. For example, SUCCESS(6, "Succeeded")
Status.description_zh:
任务状态：

未运行：上游实例未全部成功。例如，NOT_RUN(1, "未运行")。

等待定时时间（dueTime/cycleTime）到来。例如，WAIT_TIME(2, "等待时间")。

已经下发到执行引擎，在等待排队调度执行。例如，WAIT_RESOURCE(3, "等待资源")。

执行中。例如，RUNNING(4, "运行中")。

执行完毕，已经下发进行数据校验。例如，CHECKING(7, "校验中")。

执行完毕，正在进行分支条件校验。例如，CHECKING_CONDITION(8, "条件检测中")。

执行失败。例如，FAILURE(5, "运行失败")。

执行成功。例如，SUCCESS(6, "运行成功")

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
